bug_summary: compressResponseWriter.Closeがcw.writer()(isCompressableで分岐)を経由していたため、非圧縮時に実際にラップされたエンコーダwriterがCloseされずリソースがリークしていた
pr_title: Close the underlying writer directly in compressResponseWriter
pr_description: Close() was routing through the writer() accessor, which exists to pick between the raw and compressed writer during encoding selection. Since Close only needs the concrete writer instance, this asserts on cw.w directly and skips the extra indirection.
